profile.headline: Full Stack Developer | Climber
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
profile.summary: I have a passion for working with people and solving new problems everyday. My back story starts in the outdoor industry. After five years, I was ready to start a new career path in life. During my career search, I looked into software development and started to learn on my own. I was quickly infatuated with problem solving, decision making, and the team collaboration aspects. The idea of building something that could positively impact the outdoor recreations’ world is really exciting to me. I hope to find myself on a team where I can meaningfully contribute while stretching my brain and working with passionate people every day.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description: Skills: .NET Framework · C# · Angular · TypeScript · MySQL

positions.title: Back End Web Development Student
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City Metropolitan Area · Remote
positions.description:
During my tenure at Turing School of Software and Design, I specialized in the Back-end program, where I gained extensive knowledge and practical experience in software engineering principles. While my primary focus was on back-end development, I also honed skills in full-stack application development.

Key accomplishments and skills:

- Designed, built, and maintained complex web applications using Ruby on Rails as the core framework.

- Developed and consumed RESTful APIs, integrating various data sources and services into cohesive web platforms.

- Demonstrated proficiency in front-end technologies including HTML and CSS, ensuring seamless user experiences.

- Utilized GIT and GitHub for version control, code reviews, and collaborative coding.

- Collaborated in several team-based projects, which fortified my skills in agile methodologies, team communication, and software development best practices.

- Actively mentored peers, fostering a collaborative learning environment and assisting in their technical growth
positions.insights: Skills: Documentation · MySQL · Ruby on Rails · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · API Development · Test-Driven Development · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML · Active Record · Collaborative Problem Solving · GitHub · PostgreSQL · Model-View-Controller (MVC) · REST APIs

positions.title: Front of House Manager
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States · On-site
positions.description: I was responsible for creating Standard Operating Procedures to ensure efficient workflows between front and back of house operations. I also solved any problems relating to mobile ordering, toast, and equipment malfunctions in front or back of house. I was the point person for conflict resolution between employees and for the guests. Recruiting and building a team of customer centric employees providing a consistent quality of customer service for our guests.
positions.insights: Skills: Restaurant Management · Food and Beverage Operations · Team Building · Customer Service · Customer Retention

positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States

positions.title: Assistant Retail Manager
positions.description: During my tenure I was responsible for creating Standard Operating Procedures regarding pre-seasons, adjustments, retail space layout and design, and inventory tracking. This involved interdepartmental collaboration to ensure cohesive workflows. Training staff on the functionality of merchandise and best use cases for individual products.

positions.title: Front Desk Lead
positions.description: Ensuring that daily, weekly, and monthly tasks were completed efficiently and done well. Providing guidance to new staff and team building/ creating a positive work environment for staff. I was the point person for customer conflict resolution.

positions.title: Lead Guide
positions.description: I was the point person concerning logistics of trips, staffing, and ensuring that all customers have the experience that they came for. Point person for medical emergencies and or any hiccups in trip functions.

company.name: Alaska Mountain Guides and Climbing School

positions.title: Glacier Guide
positions.description: Based out of Haines, we took clients into the wilderness for multi-day expeditions to learn how to safely explore the backcountry. This includes trip preparations such as food, equipment, and medical. We taught risk management principles regarding the navigation of varying types of terrain such as glacier, snow, and rock. Teaching LNT, crevasse rescue, high angle rescue, and avalanche dangers.
